prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a four-keyframe animation sheet for a premium fashion software carousel. Create EXACTLY FOUR equal square images in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid, ideally 1024x1024 overall. Frame order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each tile contains the SAME adorable, professionally crafted miniature illustration: a softly rounded open sketchbook showing a simple jacket sketch, a short chubby pencil actively sketching it, and one tiny idea sparkle. Style: elegant cute white clay/paper 3D icon with soft pale-grey dimensional shading, tactile matte surfaces, clean silhouette, polished studio illustration. White and neutral greys ONLY. The illustration must look beautiful and sophisticated, not a vector diagram or crude line icon. All four frames have IDENTICAL objects, shape, scale, fixed camera, position and lighting; only the pencil tip subtly moves left, center, right, center to make a seamless short drawing animation and the small sparkle changes size subtly. Center each illustration inside its own equal tile, occupy about 72% of that tile, generous identical transparent padding. Genuinely transparent alpha background everywhere outside the cutout objects. NO solid background, no grid lines, no borders, no frame labels, no letters, no numbers, no typography, no colored accents, no hands, no person, no watermark. Do not merge the four illustrations or cross tile boundaries. This will be cropped into FOUR individual animation frames of the same subject, so consistency is essential.
